t: The effects of DBS on the motor symptoms of Parkinson's Disease

q.x: You should see this video to really understand how impressive dbs technology is. Incredible doesn't even begin to describe it. [link]

desc: Andrew was diagnosed with Early Onset Parkinson's Disease in 2009 when he was 35 years old. In November 2012 and February 2013 he underwent a surgical procedure, Deep Brain Stimulation surgery, to help control his motor symptoms. This has been hugely beneficial to his quality of life. This is his experience of how DBS has helped him and in the usual manner, results may vary.
